name: DNS Records
description: DNS zone data and network configuration records represent a high-value intelligence target because they expose internal topology, naming conventions, service locations, and trust relationships. Failures in classification enforcement mean this data is often treated as public-facing operational data rather than sensitive network intelligence. Lifecycle gaps — including indefinite retention of stale records, absent encryption at rest for zone files, weak access controls on zone transfer data, and no formal disposal process for decommissioned records — create persistent exposure windows for reconnaissance and lateral movement enablement.
